title: Assertion: Registered Sum
constraints: Rule: the design registers `a + b` (9-bit, no overflow): at every edge, `y` must equal the sum of the `a` and `b` sampled at the previous edge.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `$past(expr)` is the value of expr at the previous sample.
`1'b1 |=> y == $past(a + b)` or `y == $past(a) + $past(b)` with widths extended to 9 bits.
Mind the width: 8-bit + 8-bit must be evaluated in 9 bits (`9'(a) + b`).
